Ravindra Shantinath Kale vs The State Of Maharashtra And
Others on 15 May, 2024

 In The High Court Of Judicature Of Bombay
Bench At Aurangabad

Criminal Appeal No. 440 Of 2024
 Ravindra Shantinath Kale
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Others

.... 
Mr. Y. G. Birajdar, Advocate h/f Mr. S. S. Deshmukh, Advocate for
appellant
Mrs Mansi N. Ghanekar, App for respondent Nos. 1 and 2 - State
 ....
 Coram : R. M. Joshi, J.
 (Vacation Court)
 Date : 15 May 2024

PER COURT :-
1. Heard.
2. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 21.06.2024.
The learned App waives service of notice for respondent Nos. 1 and 2 - State.

3. The learned Counsel for the appellant submits that the informant had levelled the similar allegations against the appellant in the FIR bearing Crime No.197/2021 and in Special  1 of 3  (( 2 )) 3-Cri-Apeal-440-2024 Ravindra Shantinath Kale vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130684859/

Hence, the following order:-

ORDER (I) Till the next date, in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with Crime No. 0107/2024,
registered with Nanalpeth Police Station, Dist. Parbhani for the offence punishable U/Sections 376,
323, 506 of Indian Penal Code and Under Sections 3(1) (r), 3(1)
(s), 3(1)(w) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act., he shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount.
